sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: The pilot only gave us {NUMBER} complete responses.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: That's thin for the subgroup analysis.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: It's fine for the main comparison, though.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We drop the subgroup analysis and keep the main comparison as planned.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Okay, makes sense.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: I'm worried about the subgroup analysis.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: With {NUMBER} complete responses from the pilot, I agree it's thin.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: The main comparison is still solid.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Then the subgroup analysis is dropped and the main comparison stays.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Good.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Go ahead, {S1}.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Do we put out a preprint or wait for the journal?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Review could take months.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: And another lab presented similar results at a workshop on {DATE_ABS}.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Okay, so {DATE_ABS}.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Let's post the preprint now and submit to the journal in parallel.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Agreed.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Another group showed similar findings at the workshop on {DATE_ABS}.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: {DATE_ABS} comes around fast.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: And journal review will take months.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Fair enough, {S2}.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: So we post a preprint now and submit to the journal at the same time.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Good, that makes me feel better.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: There are two ways to handle the missing survey answers.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: We can drop those participants or impute the values.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Dropping them would remove {PERCENT} of the sample.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Did you say {PERCENT}?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We impute, and report results with and without imputation in the appendix.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Fine.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: If we just drop incomplete responses, we lose {PERCENT} of the sample.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Wait, {PERCENT}?

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Imputation, then?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Yes, we impute, with a sensitivity check without imputation in the appendix.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Sounds right.
